## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
Rotation, not Risk-On or Risk-Off. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive (Broad strength). XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) while XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) and XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) — sector rotation away from tech into energy/utilities confirms the regime.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress signal reads negative: HYG (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%) CORRECTION vs LQD (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND → HYG/LQD ↓ falling (credit stress rising). Volatility mixed but rising in ETF terms: VXX (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising; Stocks vs Bonds muted: SPY (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%) BELOW TREND and TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) ABOVE TREND → SPY/TLT → flat.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tighter financial conditions: UUP (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION and yield-curve ↑ rising (Level up) while TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) signals duration demand.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Defensive and energy leadership: XLU ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%), XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +9.34%), XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%); Tech and Financials lag: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%), XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%). Style: Defensive/cyclicals over Growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US softening vs select peers: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%), EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +3.01%), EWJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +8.40%), FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed speculative flows: ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -7.64%), IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -0.72%), IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%) — short-duration speculation uneven.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation bias intact: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%), GLD RECOVERY (1W: +3.23% | 1M: -2.19%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing clear strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%); natural gas weak: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLE and XLU ABOVE TREND in both timeframes; DIVERGENCE: multiple 1W vs 1M corrections across mid/small caps and industrials (XLI, IJR, IJS) — minor divergences, no major multi-core divergence noted.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor defensive and energy exposure via XLU (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%), XLP (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +9.34%) and XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%); reduce exposure to XLK (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) and XLF (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%); monitor credit via HYG/LQD and VXX.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%), XLU (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%), XLRE (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +7.32%) showing strength.  
BEARISH: XLK (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%), XLF (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%) showing weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%), CPER (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%), WEAT (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +8.09%).  
BEARISH: UNG (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%), URA (1W: -0.04% | 1M: -12.09%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX elevated (~VXX 1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) watch 30 for reflexivity; HYG/LQD tilt watch point for credit stress (current HYG -0.35% vs LQD +0.08%); XLK/XLF ratio at 2.6980 (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -1.63%) is a growth/value pivot to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, with strength concentrated in energy, utilities and staples. Key risk: tech and financials showing weakness (XLK and XLF BELOW TREND) while credit signals (HYG/LQD) and VXX are flashing caution — monitor credit and volatility.
